changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. Confirmed via Richfield Township's own February 17, 2026 meeting minutes (primary source), which record Trustee Loeffler presenting 'a resolution establishing a temporary moratorium' with the stated scope (data center facilities, energy-producing/storage facilities, commercial/industrial high-energy-use facilities in all zoning districts) and reference 'attached resolution 021726-01 adopting the resolution establishing a 12-month moratorium.' No rescission, repeal, or amendment was found in the township's subsequent March 18, 2026 meeting minutes (the most recent written minutes located), which instead note a trustee's report from a Lake Erie Regional Meeting discussing data centers regionally with no mention of repealing the township's own pause. Note: Richfield Township is in Lucas County (Anthony Wayne-area, near Whitehouse/Waterville), distinct from the separate Village of Richfield in Summit County, which passed its own, unrelated data center moratorium (Ordinance 18-2026) around the same time; some search results conflate the two.
